final: WITH matched AS (SELECT o.mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY = f.orderslink COLLATE BINARY), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(net_rate) AS rate FROM matched), pairs AS (SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_rate) AS rate FROM matched GROUP BY mktnote) SELECT AVG(pairs.rate) AS average_net_fee_rate, AVG(pairs.rate - benchmark.rate) AS average_excess FROM pairs CROSS JOIN benchmark WHERE pairs.rate > benchmark.rate
